title: feat(plugin-auth): import-users assigns positions from a `positions` column
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi93wBXqBG95NSfVqXRSzNT9n)_

Fixes #33113

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：管理员批量导入用户（`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users`）新增一列 `positions`（岗位机器名，多个用 `;` 分隔），用户建好后第二遍逐个指派岗位；控制台用户导入向导多了这一列和一句列说明。
- 为什么改：按裁决 6920428750「C，只加岗位列」，托管演示组织和真实客户都能用一份 CSV 建好带岗位、带上级的人员，下游应用不再自写建账号脚本。
- 风险与回滚：只加不减，不带 `positions` 列的文件行为不变；岗位按管理员自己的权限写入，和 Setup 里指派岗位走同一套校验；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts` 的 `assignRowPositions` 与第二遍循环；同文件 `grantBlocked` 那段（缺 seam 或管理员自身上下文解析不出时，用户照建，只把每个岗位逐行记为被拒，code 分别是 `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / `PERMISSION_DENIED`）；`auth-plugin.ts` 新增的一行 `createGrant`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts -t positions`，预期 13 例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users` admits one new column, `positions`, per the maintainer's ruling 6920428750 (verbatim: 「C，只加岗位列，p1」).

- **The column.** `positions` holds position machine names, several separated by `;` (an array on a JSON row). The name and spelling are the ones `admin/import-sso-users` already reads (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.ts:188` and `:590` on `main`, documented at `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx:1294`), so one CSV shape serves both identity import doors. Reading of the ruling: 「只加岗位列」 limits the import to this one new column; it does not limit the column to one value, since a user may hold several positions and the sibling door's column already carries a list. The cell is parsed by the one reader both doors now import (`name-list-cell.ts`, moved out of `pending-sso-users.ts` unchanged and not re-exported from the package index).
- **Second pass, like `manager_id`.** The cell is stripped before the identity write and assigned after `runImport` returns, beside the manager pass, so every row of the batch exists.
- **Same checks as Setup.** Each assignment is a `sys_user_position` insert through the data engine under the importing administrator's own execution context, through the `createGrant` seam create-user and the pending doors already use (`auth-plugin.ts` gains one line wiring it into this mount). The position catalog refusal, the delegated-administration gate and the grant-holder membership refusal judge it as they judge Setup's form; none is re-derived in the importer.
- **Per row, the user still created.** `rows[].positions` lists each named position with `assigned`, `already_assigned` (an upserted user who already holds it; nothing written), `unresolved` (the refusal is the catalog's `fields[].field === 'position'` / `reference_not_found`) or `refused` (any other refusal, with its `code`). A cell that is not a list reads `'unreadable'`. The sentence rides `rows[].error` when free; no `rows[].code` is stamped, for the manager pass's documented reason. `summary.positions` counts `{ assigned, alreadyAssigned, unresolved, refused }`, and the run-level audit row carries the same split. The import only adds positions.
- **A host that cannot judge the grant costs the positions, never the users.** When the host wires no grant seam, or the caller's own execution context does not resolve, the users are still created (`200`, the answer `main` gives the same file) and every named position is reported `refused` on its row, with code `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` (no seam) or `PERMISSION_DENIED` (no context), counted under `summary.positions.refused`; nothing is written to `sys_user_position`. Dry runs do not assign, and a dry run answers as `main` does. The open question was first read as **A** at L1 review (refuse the whole file `501` / `403` before any write; a reading, not a ruling, and withdrawn in L1 comment 6936586013) and is now **per row**, because A narrowed the same input: on `main` that file answers `200` and creates the users (see Acceptance notes, FROM). Per row is also what ruling 6920428750 says of a position that cannot be assigned.
- **No permission-set column** (ADR-0090: a position carries its sets). `demoStaff` is untouched and stays development-only.
- **Console.** The Users import wizard offers `positions` as a target column, and its options panel explains it (`console.identityImport.positionsHint`, added to all 11 `@object-ui/i18n` packs, as `all-locales-key-parity` requires).
- **Docs.** `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` › Bulk Import Users documents the column and its outcomes, including that an unreadable cell's `rows[].positions` is the string `'unreadable'` (counted under `summary.positions.unresolved`), not an array, and that positions which cannot be judged at all are refused per row (`NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / `PERMISSION_DENIED`) while the users are still created.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts`: the existing harness gains an optional grant seam and a `sys_user_position` insert double that refuses an unknown name the way the catalog refusal does and a denied one with `PERMISSION_DENIED` — only for non-system writes, so a system-context write would slip past it and fail the assertions. A new top-level `describe` holds 13 cases: assignment under the administrator's context after the last create; CSV `;` parsing; unresolved per row with every other row landing; refused with the code; `already_assigned` on upsert; unreadable cell; the cell never reaching `createUser`; no seam needed without the column; a **FROM control** (the file measured on `main`, on a host with no seam: `200`, both users created, `summary.errors: 0`, both rows `ok`); no seam → every named position `refused` / `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` on its row, the row without the column untouched, `summary.positions.refused: 3`, nothing written; no context → `refused` / `PERMISSION_DENIED`, the user created and `ok`; a dry run with no seam answers `200` with nothing written and no refusal; dry run assigns nothing.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/identityImportFields.emailRule-11913.test.tsx`: a new top-level `describe` pins the `positions` target column and the options-panel hint.
- No existing assertion was changed. The manager-pass harness gained an optional grant seam and a `sys_user_position` double; its existing cases are untouched.

## Acceptance notes

- **FROM, measured on `origin/main` d4c0c1210.** `main`'s `admin-import-users.ts`, driven with a `sys_user` declaration reader and two rows carrying a non-empty `positions` cell (`sales_rep`; `sales_rep;area_manager`), answered `200`, `summary.created: 2`, `errors: 0`, both rows `ok: true` / `created`, as JSON rows and as CSV; `createUser` received only `email` and `name`. The dry run answered `200`, two rows `created`, nothing written. So on `main` the column is **silently dropped and the users are created**. Against that FROM this PR only widens: the column now assigns positions, and every input that answered `200` and created users on `main` still does. An earlier revision of this PR refused that file whole (`501` on a host with no grant seam, `403` when the caller's own context does not resolve), which narrowed the same input; that revision is withdrawn. Those two cases now create the users as `main` does and report each named position `refused` (`NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / `PERMISSION_DENIED`) on its row; the FROM control test pins the `200` and the created users. Hence `Clause-②: yes (widening)` with no `(narrowing)` arm.
- Scope of the acceptance: a single-organization deployment, where an imported user is given the default organization's membership by the `user.create.after` reconciler before the position is written. In multi-organization mode `import-users` does not join the importing admin's current organization (unlike create-user), so the grant-holder membership refusal answers each position `refused` / `VALIDATION_FAILED` on its row; the user is still created. Filed: #34535.
- The Console import wizard offers no `manager_id` target column today, although the endpoint has admitted it since its own ruling; filed: #34536.
- The skills that teach the import are a separate `domain:skills` card, per the claim; filed: #34537.
- The tenant-audit census page and its counts file move by one write call site (the new grant insert); the figures are re-measured, not edited by hand.
- `already_assigned` reads an existing hold by `(user_id, position)` regardless of organization, for upserted rows only.

## Verification

<details><summary>Targeted tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts src/pending-sso-users.test.ts src/admin-import-users.test.ts` → `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 151 passed (151)` (VERDICT command-exit 0, r3 head).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` → `Test Files 280 passed (280)`, `Tests 5780 passed | 10 skipped (5790)` (r3 head).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` → exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK` (r3 head).
- `ui`: `vitest run` of `identityImport.test.ts`, `identityImportFields.emailRule-11913.test.tsx`, `identityImport.csvBatches-13315.test.tsx` and all of `packages/i18n/` → `Test Files 105 passed (105)`, `Tests 1924 passed | 13 skipped` (VERDICT command-exit 0, r1; r3 does not touch `ui/`). The zh-Hant line is the generator's output (`node scripts/gen-zh-hant.mjs`), and the de line avoids a quote pair so the `de-quote-pairing` count pin stays as it is.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` → VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation landed on disk via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, then restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

1. (r1) Assignment written under `SYSTEM_CTX` instead of the administrator's context → 3 cases red (the context assertion and the two refusal cases, since the checks stand down for system writes).
2. (r1) Second pass skipped → 6 red.
3. (r3) The withdrawn whole-file refusal restored (an early `return fail(501, 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED', …)` when the file names positions and no seam is wired) → 2 red: the FROM control and the per-row `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` case.
4. (r3) The per-row refusal branch disabled (`if (grantBlocked && false)`) → 2 red: the `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` and `PERMISSION_DENIED` cases.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 111 commands on head d3c32ee1c (r1), on the r2 head d69957c3c, and on the r3 head 987b7e725 (after the per-row change and a merge of `main`; `packages/spec` was rebuilt first because the merge moved its sources); each was run with stdin closed and its exit captured before any pipe: all 111 exit 0 on each head. On r3, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` first exited 1 on one 15 s test timeout (`check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts` › main passes exactly the arguments…) while the plugin-auth full suite shared the box; the file alone then passed 152/152, and the whole family re-run on an idle box exited 0, which is the exit recorded. `--ran` reconciliation on each head: `111 derived, 111 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `check:tenant-audit-census` first read the new `sys_user_position` insert as one more engine write call site (321 → 322); the generated tables were rewritten with `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write` and the page's hand-written figures moved by one in the same commit (`content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx`, `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`). Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check runs.

</details>
